The Guard Kit

A warden that runs in your Cloudflare account. Your keys never leave your infrastructure — because there is no CostWarden server to send them to.

What it does

  • Deploys to your own Cloudflare Worker with a one-click Deploy button (~10 minutes)
  • Polls OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter spend on your schedule
  • Alerts your Slack at 50% / 80% / 100% of the daily budget you set
  • At 100%, automatically disables the runaway key where the provider's API allows it — and where it doesn't, sends a maximum-urgency alert instead (no fake promises)
  • Configuration is environment variables only. No admin panel, no database, nothing to babysit

What it deliberately is not

Not a hosted SaaS. Not a proxy — it cannot block a single request before it happens, and billing data lags at every provider, so treat it as a fast brake, not a wall. Not an observability platform: no traces, no evals, no dashboards you'll never open.

Price: $59, one-time. No subscription.
